title: Discount codes at checkout
instruction: Add discount-code support to Cart.totals(region, { codes, discounts }). codes is an array of requested code strings; discounts is an object keyed by exact case-sensitive code with records { type: "percentage" | "fixed", value, minimumSubtotal }. Eligibility is based on the original two-decimal subtotal (minimum inclusive, defaults to 0). Ignore unknown or ineligible codes; apply each code at most once. Apply eligible percentages in requested-code order first, rounding the remaining balance to cents after each percentage, then eligible fixed amounts in requested-code order, flooring the balance at zero. Tax the discounted balance. When codes is nonempty, return discount (original minus discounted subtotal), while subtotal remains the original amount; total is discounted subtotal plus tax. With no codes preserve the existing result shape. Configuration records are trusted: percentages 0–100, fixed amounts nonnegative. Do not mutate inputs. Add useful tests.
